title: Foundations for Accurate Academic English
focus: Revisar frase, concordância e tempo verbal
verifiableTask: Corrigir oito frases com erros de base

content.text: Ao final da aula você consegue:
encontrar e corrigir os erros de base mais comuns de brasileiros em frases sobre dados, opiniões e experiências.
corrigir oito frases com erros de base.
Responda com frases completas e no tempo certo:
What did you study at school/university? (passado)
How long have you lived in your city? (presente perfeito)
What are you going to do after the IELTS? (futuro)
diga sua meta de band e sua prioridade.
Verbos muito usados no IELTS (Writing Task 1 e 2):
information · research · advice · equipment · knowledge · evidence · traffic · pollution · furniture
The number of students rises every year, but research shows that traffic remains a problem.

options.text: There are many researches about this.
There is a lot of research about this.
There is a research about this.

explanations.general: Correct answer: There is a lot of research about this.

questions.questionText: Cars ______ for 60% of emissions in the city. (representam)

explanations.general: Cars account for 60% of emissions in the city.
Correct answer: remain
Pollution affects people's health.

options.text: Traffics are terrible in my city.
Traffic is terrible in my city.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Traffic is terrible in my city.
The price reached a peak in 2020.

content.text: In my city have many parks.

In my country, the number of people who work from home has increased a lot since 2020. There are many advantages, but research shows that some workers feel isolated. In my opinion, companies should offer a mix of office and home days.
4.1 Troque e fale: concordância e tempo
→ tourists / increased (2015–2020) → students / has doubled (since 2000) → workers / is expected to fall (by 2030)
→ necessary / reduce traffic → essential / invest in education → difficult / find affordable housing
Is very difficult find a job nowadays.
The number of tourists have increased.
In 2010, the sales increase a lot.
Since 2015, the government invested in schools.
Exist many solutions for this problem.

questions.questionText: ______ is very difficult to find a job nowadays. (sujeito)

explanations.general: It is very difficult to find a job nowadays.
The number of tourists has increased.
Correct answer: People are more connected today.
In 2010, sales increased a lot.
Correct answer: has invested

options.text: There are many solutions to this problem.
Exist many solutions to this problem.
Have many solutions to this problem.

explanations.general: Correct answer: There are many solutions to this problem.

questions.questionText: “A number of people ______ unhappy with the plan.”

explanations.general: Correct answer: are

content.text: Sublinhe, corrija e diga o tipo (S sujeito/verbo · C concordância · T tempo · I incontável).
Nowadays, exist many people who work online.
The percentage of women in politics have risen since 1990.
Is clear that technology help students.
Governments should give more informations to citizens.
Everyone in my family like football.
Over the last decade, tourism grew significantly in my city.
The police is investigating the case.

the number of / everyone / people / police
Escreva uma frase com cada verbo-chave sobre dados do seu país (invente números plausíveis só para praticar).
Escreva 9 frases, uma com cada substantivo incontável da aula.
Escreva 3 frases em cada tempo da seção 3.
Leia o modelo da seção 3 em voz alta 3 vezes. Grave sua versão sobre outro tema.
How has your city changed in the last ten years?
Working from home: advantages and disadvantages.

questions.questionText: Nowadays, ______ are many people who work online. (estrutura de existência)

explanations.general: Nowadays, there are many people who work online.

questions.questionText: The percentage of women in politics ______ risen since 1990.

explanations.general: The percentage of women in politics has risen since 1990.
In 2005, the factory produced 2,000 cars.

options.text: It is clear that technology helps students.
Is clear that technology help students.

explanations.general: Correct answer: It is clear that technology helps students.
Correct answer: Governments should give more information.
Everyone in my family likes football.

explanations.A: Correto: “over the last decade” = até agora.
explanations.general: Correct answer: has grown

content.text: 1 It is very difficult to find a job nowadays. 2 …has increased. 3 People are… 4 …sales increased… 5 …has invested… 6 There are many solutions to this problem.
1 there are many people (S) · 2 has risen (C) · 3 produced (T) · 4 It is clear that technology helps (S + C) · 5 information (I) · 6 likes (C) · 7 has grown (T) · 8 The police are (C).
